Figure 2: Overview of TOCOMAS. Task-derived responsibility regions organize agents, handoffs,
and memory boundaries; online evolution preserves their coherence.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed the final TOCOMAS figure and reviewed source-pair evidence and source caption. The top task topology, Agents A/B/C, typed memory graphs, and legend remain complete; the lower six-step evolution loop retains feedback, proposals, screening, evaluation, accepted/rejected choices, and the next pool. Three entire scientific bands are restored at 2x nearest-neighbor. Four upward coupling shafts are extended across whitespace at their original x coordinates and retain their original arrowheads/destinations. The new Online Structural Evolution banner and reading guide describe the existing process, without adding dependencies.
